name: Kotihaltija
body:
KOTIHALTIJA
CR 4

This fey appears as an elderly bearded man sternly overseeing a small farm from a perch upon its roof.

XP 1,200
N Medium fey (haltija)
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +16

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 15, flat-footed 16 (+3 armor, +4 Dex, +1 dodge, +3 natural)
hp 39 (7d6+14)
Fort +4, Ref +9, Will +8
Defensive Abilities bar the door, domain warden; DR 5/cold iron

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 30 ft.
Melee +1 quarterstaff +6 (2d6+4)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks hearth’s revolt
Spell-like Abilities (CL 7th; concentration +10)

Constant—shillelagh
At will—ethereal jaunt (self only), invisibility, open/close
1/day—alarm, arcane lock, knock

Spells Prepared (CL 7th; concentration +8)

4th—scrying
3rd—cure serious wounds, spike growth (DC 16), wind wall
2nd—barkskin (already cast), flaming sphere (DC 15), gust of wind, lesser restoration
1st—entangle (DC 14), goodberry, magic stone, obscuring mist, produce flame
0th—create water, detect magic, mending, purify food and drink

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 18, Con 14, Int 14, Wis 17, Cha 16
Base Atk +3; CMB +5; CMD 19
Feats Improved Initiative, Dodge, Skill Focus (perception), Mobility
Skills Acrobatics +13, Bluff +13, Diplomacy +13, Disguise +13, Escape Artist +13, Perception +16, Sleight of Hand +13, Stealth +15
Languages Common, Sylvan
Gear quarterstaff, leather armor, 2 potions of cure moderate wounds, potion of remove disease

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bar the Door (Su)

When a kotihaltija uses its arcane lock spell-like ability on any door in their domain, it affects all doors, windows, and similar portals within 30 feet for 1 hour, and the entire domain is affected as dimensional lock. When it uses its alarm spell-like ability, it is alerted by the spell when a creature not attuned to the spell enters or leaves the area.

Domain Warden (Ex)

As a haltija.

Find the Lost (Sp)

A kotihaltija can use locate creature or locate object at will as spell-like abilities, but only within their domain or to locate their warded creature.

Hearth’s Revolt (Su)

As a haltija, but the save DC is 16.

Spells (Su)

A kotihaltija casts spells as a 7th-level druid but can’t swap out prepared spells to cast summon spells.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

Household haltija, these fey spirits are bound to homes, hearths, farms, and family dwellings. A kindly kotihaltija keeps watch over the sleeping household, nudges lost tools back into sight, guards food stores from spoilage, and turns aside small misfortunes before mortals ever notice them. Many families honor such a spirit with bread, milk, handcrafts, or a place left clean beside the fire. This subtype is nearly always female.

When angered, neglected, or forced to defend her home, a kotihaltija becomes the house’s hidden wrath.

Doors slam shut, windows seal, shutters hammer like fists, embers leap from the hearth, chairs topple beneath intruders, and every familiar object becomes a weapon in the spirit’s unseen hands.

Kotihaltijas are rarely cruel without cause but are fiercely territorial. Those threatening their household may find entering the home easy but leaving alive much more difficult.
